errors.forbidden: You do not have access to this page.
errors.request: The request could not be completed.
errors.unexpected: Something went wrong. Try again in a moment.
errors.conflict: Someone else changed this just now. Reload and try again.

packs.title: Add-ons
packs.description: À-la-carte feature packs a customer buys on top of their plan, such as "Campaigns add-on" or "+1 WhatsApp number". Each add-on grants the feature toggles and limits you set on it, merged onto the customer's plan. They appear on the customer's Account page once they are on an active plan.

delete.title: Delete {name}?
delete.body: Delete this add-on? Workspaces that bought it keep it until it expires.
delete.inUse: {count, plural, one {# workspace owns this add-on, so it cannot be deleted. Disable it instead; owners keep it until it ends.} other {# workspaces own this add-on, so it cannot be deleted. Disable it instead; owners keep it until it ends.}}

errors.generic: The add-on could not be saved.
errors.forbidden: Only a super admin can change add-ons.

editor.intro: An add-on grants ONLY what you switch on and nothing else. A limit left blank is not touched, so there is no accidental "unlimited".
editor.featuresHint: Tick only what this add-on grants. Everything unticked stays governed by the customer's plan.
editor.limitsHint: Blank = the add-on does not touch this limit. Enter a number to ADD on top of the plan (for example +2 devices). Use -1 for unlimited.

problems.name: Enter a name.
problems.amount: Enter an amount such as 19 or 19.99.
problems.offerAmount: The offer must be lower than the price.
problems.billingDuration: Enter a whole number of 1 or more.
problems.limits: Limits are whole numbers, or -1 for unlimited.

extensions.title: Add-ons
extensions.description: Add-ons merge extra features into this installation. Instagram is the first. Verify your purchase code, upload the package, and it installs in place. Your data and settings are untouched.
extensions.packsLead: Looking for the paid feature packs customers buy on top of a plan?

installed.title: Installed add-ons
installed.empty: No add-ons installed yet. Verify your purchase code above, then upload a package.
installed.footnote: Removing an add-on deletes only the files it installed, tracked from the moment it was added, so core files are never touched. Data stays in the database.

verify.title: Verify your purchase code
verify.body: The same {brand} licence that unlocks updates. Add-ons are tied to it.
verify.label: Purchase code

upload.title: Upload the add-on package
upload.body: The ZIP is inspected before anything is written. A malformed or incompatible package is refused with your install untouched.
upload.progress: Uploading and merging. Do not close this tab.

confirm.removeBody: This deletes the files it installed. Its data stays in the database.
confirm.moduleOffBody: This deactivates the add-on, so its pages and automations stop running. The files are kept, so you can re-activate it any time. Nothing is deleted, and its data stays in the database.
confirm.moduleOnBody: This turns the add-on back on. Its files are still on disk, so it starts working again immediately.

instagram.title: Instagram
instagram.body: Runs as a separate {brand} deployment. Connect by URL + secret, no upload.
instagram.blockedNote: Native Instagram add-on is installed. Remove it below to connect a remote {brand}.
instagram.modalBody: Paste your {brand} deployment URL and the shared secret token. {app} verifies the connection over API. Nothing is uploaded.
instagram.brandHint: Shown on every "Sync from …", "Manage on …" and "… URL" label across the app.
instagram.disconnectBody: This disconnects Instagram from {app}. Instagram will immediately disappear from the dashboard, analytics, inbox, flows, templates and auto-replies for every workspace, and none of it can be used until you reconnect. Continue?

email.title: Email
email.body: Connecting links the {brand} email platform so mail lands in the team inbox, by URL + secret, no upload.
email.modalBody: Paste your {brand} deployment URL and the shared secret token. {app} verifies the connection over API. Nothing is uploaded.
email.brandHint: Shown on every email label across the app.
email.disconnectBody: This disconnects the email platform from {app}. Mail stops landing in the team inbox for every workspace until you reconnect. Continue?

errors.forbidden: Only a super admin can change modules.
errors.coreTooOld: This package needs a newer core version.
errors.engineConflict: Instagram runs one engine at a time. Disconnect the other one first.

workspace.title: Add-ons
workspace.description: Extra feature packs you buy on top of your subscription.
workspace.needPlanBody: Add-ons are extra feature packs you buy on top of your subscription. Choose a plan first, then come back here to add features.
workspace.noneBody: There are no add-ons offered right now. Check back later.
workspace.ownedBody: Active packs merged onto your current plan.
workspace.catalogBody: Unlock extra features on top of your current plan. No plan change needed.
workspace.error: The add-ons could not be loaded.
